name: 22042 · Falls Church, VA
findings: ZIP 22042 (Falls Church) has 171 nonprofit organizations. 82 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 69 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22042 (Falls Church) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 22042 (Falls Church) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 69 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
